hero_meta: How modern teams work, meet, and celebrate at Den 1880
intro_paragraph: At Den 1880, we’ve seen teams use our space in all kinds of creative, productive, and impactful ways. From strategy sessions to social events, our versatile venue in Uptown Waterloo is designed to support the many ways modern teams come together. Whether you're planning your next corporate offsite or just need a fresh setting to spark ideas, here are 10 inspiring ways to use Den 1880.
cta_heading: Bring your team in to see it
cta_subhead: We'll show you the Theatre, the Library, The Vault, and the Performance Club, then you can decide.
